sum: Amplify Energy Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, development, exploitation, and production of oil and natural gas properties in the United States. The company's assets consist primarily of the Beta field located in federal waters offshore from the Port of Long Beach, California; and Bairoil properties which include wells and properties primarily located in the Lost Soldier and Wertz fields in Wyoming at Bairoil complex. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
